personality: 5 Brutalist Mobile with 1 iOS-Native Clean warmth
personality_one_liner: A high-trust, monochrome enterprise utility combining sharp asymmetric layouts with clean typography and absolute clarity.

spacing.rule: Generous asymmetric rhythms; strict use of safe areas; tight grouping of related metadata and generous padding around main content blocks.

do's: Use frosted glass on the bottom tab bar.
Use frosted glass on the sticky header when scrolling through the document list.
Apply glass overlay on sticky FAB or bottom action containers.
dont's: Never blur document content or form fields.
Do not use glass on simple list items or cards.

screens.name: Home (Sender Dashboard)
screens.purpose: A minimal, commanding view of all active and pending secure documents.

states.empty: Illustration of an empty folder with 'No documents yet. Create one securely.' and a primary CTA.
states.error: Failed to load documents message with 'Retry Connection' button.

screens.layout: Top section: Workspace switcher (Sender/Receiver) and subtle Profile avatar. Main area: Vertical list of documents using asymmetric staggered cards, displaying File Name, Creation Date, Status pill, and Check Status button. Bottom center: Floating FAB for 'Create File' nested inside or above a frosted glass tab bar. Bottom right: AI Assistant floating icon.

screens.name: Create File Picker
screens.purpose: Bottom sheet or dedicated screen to select the document category.
screens.layout: Grid of minimal icon tiles (NDA, Patent, Legal, Financial, Secure PDF, Normal PDF). Clean borders, no shadows. Emphasize 'Secure PDF' vs 'Normal PDF (AI)' with subtle brandSecondary accent.

screens.name: Security Configuration
screens.purpose: Dense but legible settings screen to toggle enterprise-grade security rules.
screens.layout: A scrollable list of security toggles (OTP, Face Verification, Voice Oath, Digital Signature, Dynamic Watermark, Geo Restriction, etc.). Grouped by category (Identity, Access, Tracking). Use right-aligned toggles. Explain sensitive features with muted small text below the label. Sticky 'Save & Continue' primary CTA at the bottom inside a frosted glass container.

screens.name: Receiver Verification Flow
screens.purpose: A step-by-step wizard to unlock protected content.
screens.layout: Full-screen sequential steps (OTP -> Face -> Voice -> Review -> Sign). One dominant action per screen. Large, bold typography for the step instruction. Camera preview for face/voice steps. Digital Signature pad at the end. Final confirmation unlocks the 'Protected Content' view.

screens.name: Evidence Vault
screens.purpose: Audit trail and secure storage of all agreements and verification records.

states.empty: Minimalist folder image. 'Vault is secure and empty.'

screens.layout: List of records (Agreements, Logs, Signatures). Each row shows deep metadata (timestamps, encryption status) using a monospaced text variant for numbers to emphasize auditability. Tap to expand into a detailed 'Status Tracker' showing completion percentages.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette: Near-black and warm off-white for a high-trust, Linear/Notion-style enterprise SaaS aesthetic. Do not introduce blues or purples.
Utilize asymmetric layouts for the document list: staggered cards or uneven spacing to create a dynamic, modern composition.
Typography must be sharp and web-friendly (Satoshi preferred). Limit font sizes to a strict scale and use weight sparingly (max 500) to convey hierarchy.
Implement the sticky 'Create' FAB above the bottom tab bar. Use `react-native-safe-area-context` to ensure it avoids the home indicator.
The Security Configuration screen must use clear toggle switches with explanatory subtext for sensitive features to align with mobile security best practices found during web search.
Receiver Verification Flow should feel highly sequential and focused. Use full-screen modals for each step (OTP, Face, Voice) with large typography.
Ensure the Evidence Vault feels like an audit trail. Use Monospaced fonts for timestamps and IDs to reinforce the 'secure, enterprise-grade' feeling.
Apply frosted glass selectively on sticky headers and the bottom tab bar to provide depth over scrolling content, but never over actual document contents.
